limitations: Shelter capacity is imputed from shelter type; OSDMA publishes none.
Travel distance is straight-line x 1.3 detour; no road network, so road flooding before evacuation is not modelled.
Evacuation demand is the population of modelled flood cells only; wind and rain exposure are not added to demand.
Parametric zones are illustrative, not actuarially derived.
Payout matrices are demonstrative of the mechanism only.

failure_analysis: CSI 0.001 is near zero: the predicted and observed masks barely overlap. Check the truth pipeline (orbit geometry, swath edges, date gap) before attributing this to the model.
Largest over-prediction: Ersama (67 km2 modelled wet, observed dry). Static bathtub has no drainage or embankments.
Largest miss: Puri (24 km2 observed wet, modelled dry). A surge-only model cannot represent rain-fed or riverine flooding; where that is the cause it is out of scope, not a tuning target.
Bias 2.65: the model floods more area than was observed.
First post-event pass is ~18 h after landfall; surge water that drained before the pass counts as a false alarm.
DEM vertical error (~4 m) is comparable to the surge level itself; Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model, so canopy and roofs read high.

validation.ems_crosscheck: Copernicus EMS EMSR357 exists as an independent reference; not yet ingested.

advisories.headline: Cyclone Fani 2019: Pre-Cyclone Watch Briefing for Puri + Khordha at 72.0 Hours Before Landfall
advisories.situation: Under the Pre-Cyclone Watch at 72.0 hours before landfall, heuristic model projections indicate potential inundation over 782.2 km2 with a peak surge index of 2.63 m, placing 470801 population and 19226 buildings at risk across Puri + Khordha. Model assessment identifies 29 shelters compromised out of 241 shelters total, leaving 350318 people without a shelter place. Accordingly, 4 orders are recommended for consideration by the respective Collectors and the Special Relief Commissioner to withdraw affected facilities and open temporary shelter accommodations.
caveats: Static bathtub inundation; no storm dynamics, tide phase, or timing.
No wave setup or runup, which can add more than 1 m.
DEM vertical error (several metres) is comparable to the surge signal itself in low-relief floodplains.

advisories.headline: Cyclone Fani 2019: ସ୍ଥଳଭାଗ ଛୁଇଁବାର 72.0 ଘଣ୍ଟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ Puri + Khordha ପାଇଁ Pre-Cyclone Watch ବ୍ରିଫିଂ
advisories.situation: ସ୍ଥଳଭାଗ ଛୁଇଁବାର 72.0 ଘଣ୍ଟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ Pre-Cyclone Watch ଅଧୀନରେ, ମଡେଲ୍ ଆକଳନ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ 2.63 m ର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ଜୁଆର ସୂଚକାଙ୍କ ସହିତ 782.2 km2 ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଜଳମଗ୍ନ ହେବାର ସମ୍ଭାବନା ରହିଛି, ଯାହା Puri + Khordha ରେ 470801 ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟା ଏବଂ 19226 ଟି କୋଠାବାଡ଼ିକୁ ବିପଦରେ ପକାଉଛି। ମଡେଲ୍ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନରୁ ଜଣାପଡିଛି ଯେ ମୋଟ 241 ଟି ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ 29 ଟି ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀ କ୍ଷତିଗ୍ରସ୍ତ ହୋଇଛି, ଯାହାଫଳରେ 350318 ଜଣ ଲୋକ ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳ ବିହୀନ ହୋଇଛନ୍ତି। ତଦନୁଯାୟୀ, ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ସୁବିଧାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାହାର କରିବା ଏବଂ ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଆଶ୍ରୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ଖୋଲିବା ପାଇଁ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ Collectors ଏବଂ Special Relief Commissioner ଙ୍କ ବିଚାରାର୍ଥେ 4 ଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ସୁପାରିଶ କରାଯାଇଛି।
